headline.zh: 为AI代理交易设计验证策略
headline.en: Design verification for AI agent transactions

scenario.zh: 某支付平台准备支持AI代理自动付款,需要配置身份与授权验证流程
scenario.en: A payment platform enabling AI agent autopay needs identity and authorization verification

instruction.zh: 根据交易场景选择验证深度
instruction.en: Select verification depth for transaction context

output.zh: 配置双因素检查,适用于常规代理支付场景
output.en: Two-factor checks configured for routine agent payments

label.zh: 增强验证:身份+授权+可信度

output.zh: 启用三层验证,适用于高价值或敏感交易
output.en: Three-layer verification enabled for high-value or sensitive transactions

instruction.zh: 定义AI代理可执行的操作边界
instruction.en: Define operational boundaries for AI agents

output.zh: 代理可在额度内自主完成小额支付
output.en: Agents autonomously complete small payments within limit

label.zh: 条件授权:需人工批准>1000元

output.zh: 大额交易触发人工审核流程
output.en: High-value transactions trigger human review workflow

instruction.zh: 查看不同验证配置的处理表现
instruction.en: Review processing performance of verification configs

output.zh: 验证响应快速,适合高频小额场景
output.en: Fast verification response for high-frequency small transactions

output.zh: 可信度评估增加延迟,但风险控制更严格
output.en: Trust scoring adds latency but provides stricter risk control

instruction.zh: 审阅最终的代理验证配置方案

output.zh: 验证策略已就绪,可接入AI代理支付流程
output.en: Verification strategy ready for AI agent payment integration

output.zh: 配置已保存,可稍后继续调整参数
output.en: Configuration saved for later parameter adjustments

takeaway.zh: Baselayer为AI代理交易提供身份、授权和可信度验证,帮助金融机构在代理商务化前建立信任基础设施
takeaway.en: Baselayer verifies identity, authorization and trust for AI agent transactions, helping financial institutions build trust infrastructure before agent commerce scales
